clipper.slogan: Deliver great browser content straight to your Bot
clipper.lead: Supports web clipping, screenshots, social sharing, and material basket packaging. Connect your own account with no local connector required.
clipper.unofficial: A third-party extension independently developed by 铁柱AGI, not an official product of xAI or Cursor.
clipper.videoLead: Two quick walk-through videos covering everyday features.
clipper.featuresTitle: What You Can Do With It

features.v: Clip selections, article text, images, or tables, **fully preserving source links and context**.
Supports area selection, visible viewport, and scrolling screenshots, with **free cropping, annotation, and redaction before sending**.
**Directly select a Bot to receive content** from X, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and WeChat Official Accounts, retaining body text, author, metrics, and attachments.
Collect multiple web pages, screenshots, and local files, **bundling them into a single task to send to your Bot**.
Edit instructions and attachments before sending, **previewing and verifying the exact materials your Bot will receive**.
No need to leave the current page; **view Markdown responses directly in the sidebar and continue asking questions**.

extras.v: Supports Pinyin and initial search, allowing you to favorite frequently used bots and set a default Bot.
⌘⇧/Ctrl+Shift+7 area screenshot, 8 save web page, 9 quick command
Built-in display for 55 languages and regions, matching your browser by default.
Automatically generates numbered sources and Markdown body text, converting long articles into indexes and attachments.

steps.v: Go to the Feishu document and download the installation package for your browser.
Follow the documentation guide to load the extension in your browser's extension management page.
Pin it to the toolbar, open it, and authorize your own Grok Bot account.
Select the target Bot, send the clipped materials, and view the reply in the sidebar.

faq.a: No. **This is a third-party extension independently developed by me**, not an official product of xAI or Cursor.

faq.q: Does it require a local connector or self-hosted relay?
faq.a: No. **Simply authorize your account directly in the browser**—no self-hosted relay service needed.

faq.q: Where is data stored? Is there any telemetry?
faq.a: **The extension has zero analytics telemetry**. Data and records are stored in your current browser and only sent to your chosen Bot service.
**Supports Chrome and Edge 120+**, as well as Firefox desktop 140+.

faq.q: Can videos from all social platforms be captured?
faq.a: Not guaranteed. **We cannot guarantee every video can be fetched successfully**; if unavailable, it will be clearly labeled.

faq.q: Is the extension open source? Where is the source code?
faq.a: **The code is open-sourced on GitHub**. Proprietary code uses the MIT License, while third-party code and art assets retain their respective rights.

clipper.endTitle: Deliver Web Materials to Your Bot
clipper.endText: Go to the Feishu document to download the package and try it out in your browser right away.

xiaotiezhu.slogan: Keep valuable chat insights afloat: the automated operations manager for high-value communities
xiaotiezhu.lead: 小铁柱 is a lightweight operations assistant built specifically for WeChat communities, periodically summarizing daily discussions and key highlights. Say goodbye to tedious manual scrolling and easily accumulate your community's digital assets.
xiaotiezhu.meta: WeChat Group Operations Assistant · Per-group Pricing · Ready Out of the Box
xiaotiezhu.unofficial: This service is provided by the 铁柱AGI community and is not an official WeChat product
xiaotiezhu.featuresTitle: Core Capabilities: Automated Extraction, Visual Presentation, and Long-Term Accumulation

features.v: Seamlessly joins WeChat groups to automatically organize conversations based on scheduled **routine tasks**, **supporting daily chat summaries** and generating high-res formatted long images.
Generates dedicated standalone web summaries, **structurally extracting key topics and valuable insights** so members can **browse quickly across devices** without scrolling through message history.
**Supports daily chat summaries; packages and emails daily chat content to designated inboxes**, automatically archiving chat highlights and attachments to build a solid team knowledge base.
**Custom theme included upon initial onboarding**, tailoring group headers, brand colors, and exclusive layouts; **subsequent theme changes: 100 RMB each**.

extras.v: No server or runtime environment needed; a dedicated manager assists 1-on-1, **effective immediately upon adding to the group**.
Freely set **routine task** schedule times for summary pushes and archiving, perfectly aligning with group activity routines.
Data is strictly confined to the daily summary and archiving process, never leaked or distributed, safeguarding community information security.
Enjoy dedicated customer service Q&A and status health checks throughout the service period to ensure 小铁柱 runs stably and reliably.

steps.v: Contact the operations manager on WeChat to confirm the number of groups and desired features.
Finalize the summary visual style and **routine task** trigger times to complete fast onboarding.
**Invite 小铁柱 to the group** for official delivery, and automated operations and daily digest services launch immediately.

faq.q: Do I need to prepare my own server or special accounts to activate the service?
faq.a: Not at all. 小铁柱 operates on a fully managed model: you only need to **invite 小铁柱 to the group** on WeChat, and we handle all environments and operations.

faq.q: How are pricing rules calculated if I have multiple groups?
faq.a: Invite 小铁柱 to 1 group: 79 RMB/month; for 2 or more groups: 59 RMB per group/month—the more groups you have, the better the value.

faq.q: What are the advantages of web-based chat summaries?
faq.a: Add 'Web Chat Summary' feature: +20 RMB/month. In addition to long images, group members get a dedicated link supporting structured outlines, topic filtering, and rapid browsing.

faq.q: What is the process for theme customization?
faq.a: Custom theme included upon initial onboarding; subsequent theme changes: 100 RMB each. During initial onboarding, the manager will adjust color schemes, group headers, and layout styles for you.

faq.q: Does emailing daily summaries cost extra?
faq.a: No extra fee. Included in the service: supports daily chat summaries; daily chat content is packaged and emailed to the designated inbox. Simply provide the recipient email upon activation.

xiaotiezhu.endTitle: Leave tedious organization to 小铁柱, deliver profound value to your members
xiaotiezhu.endText: A reliable manager for high-value WeChat groups—say goodbye to information overload and chat scrolling. Add the manager on WeChat now to unlock automated group operations immediately.
